items.Sentence: Raw wastewater will be conveyed to the Facility headworks, which will include two coarse screen and grit removal trains, a SAFE system box, and two parallel fine screens.
Raw wastewater will be conveyed to the Facility headworks, which will include two coarse screen and grit removal trains, a SAFE system box, and two parallel fine screens.
A concrete tank, called the SAFE settling basin, will capture and equalize the wet weather flows prior to entering the SAFE filter system.

During higher volume peak flow events, effluent will fill the SAFE settling basin, which will provide sedimentation treatment, until it passes over a weir and flows to the SAFE filter system for filtration treatment.

Screened effluent and return activated sludge will flow into two biological nutrient removal (BNR) basins and then pumped to the MBR. The BNR-MBR basins will be configured as two parallel activated sludge treatment trains, each consisting of pre-anoxic, aerobic, and post-anoxic basins in-series.

Tertiary treated effluent from the outfall balancing tank will be pumped through an outfall disinfection chlorine contact pipeline and will then be dechlorinated by sodium bisulfite injection prior to discharge through the ocean outfall.
IPR system treatment consists of cartridge filters, an RO system, ultraviolet disinfection with advanced oxidation (UV/AOP) chlorination, and a calcite contactor.

The sludge holding tanks will receive, store, and aerate activated sludge wasted from the BNR MBR process.
The sludge dewatering system will pump waste sludge from the sludge holding tanks, or directly from the MBR system, and dewatered by a belt filter press with a polymer storage and feed system.
